title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it suggests a change in the model's complexity. Consider what happens to bias and variance in this scenario.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: The bias-variance tradeoff is a fundamental concept in machine learning. Increasing the number of features can affect both bias and variance. Think about how reducing the number of features might impact these two components.

title: Effect of Reducing Features
text: Reducing the number of features typically increases bias but decreases variance. This can lead to a model that generalizes better to unseen data, hence reducing validation error.
